title: Rejection resting on a re-routing offer that is not in the record
narrative: They refused me because they say they offered me another flight. Nobody offered me anything. I found my own way there two days later.

carrier_response.text: We offered you re-routing at the time of cancellation and you did not take it up. As re-routing was offered, no compensation is payable under the applicable policy.

derivation: S4.1 notice 14 Nov 09:00 -> 17 Nov 15:50 is 3 days, under 7 days -> S4.4 governs
S4.4 the exemption requires an offer that was actually made; D3 records no rebooking actions and D4 records no such contact
S4.5 a declined offer would still count, but only if it was made, and nothing in the record shows one
S9.1(c) the rejection cites a re-routing exemption with no re-routing offer in the record -> validly challengeable
The decisive observation is the absence of a document, not the content of one
